name: ReGrind (codexrunner)
subtitle: Unofficial Grindr client, redesigned. Free, libre and ad-free
description:
A fork of Open Grind, the cross-platform, free, libre, ad-free, tracker-free,
privacy-centered and community-driven unofficial client for the Grindr queer
social network.

This fork started as an iOS port — the original builds for Android and desktop
— and grew into a redesign plus the features that were missing from daily use.
Most of the work in it was done with AI.

From Open Grind

• Unlocked grid
Unlimited profiles for free, ads removed from grid, all filters unlocked

• Location spoofing
Native geolocation change with OpenStreetMap and location search built-in

• Zero ads
No ads, first party, third party or self-promotion, no obstructive pop-ups

• Privacy by default
No analytics, zero trackers, no data is collected

• Security as foundation
Human code review, audit, supply chain security, end-to-end testing

Added in this fork

• Redesigned interface
A minimalist look throughout, redesigned settings, and your own theme, colors
and chat wallpaper

• Albums
View albums shared with you, create and edit your own, add photos and reorder
them, and share or unshare from the chat composer, with an expiry if you want
one

• Richer chat
Voice messages you record and play, video messages and locations, replies to
messages, photos and locations, media downloads a whole set at a time, and
every photo from a conversation in one gallery

• Several accounts
Sign in to more than one and switch between them, each with its own session,
location and filters

• Favorites
A favorites screen, with notes you can add to profiles and search through

• Gestures and feedback
Swipe between tabs and between profiles, haptics, and a bubble when someone
views your profile

• Blocked contacts
Manage everyone you have blocked

versions.localizedDescription:
- Renamed to ReGrind, with new artwork
- Right Now posting, with the remaining allowance on the post button
- Sent taps, video messages and voice messages added
- Voice notes drawn as waveforms, and a run of them plays through
- The Post pill morphs into the sheet it opens
- Message bubbles have their own text size
- Maps drawn with MapLibre GL instead of Leaflet
- Location sheet opening only once fixed
- Map attribution covering the picker's buttons fixed
- Lists stay on screen when a refresh fails
- A readable error when unsending a message needs Unlimited
